# Splits: both directions, before, sizes, full width and height, and running out of space.
new 80x24
split %0 -h
split %1 -v
split %0 -v -b
split %2 -h -l 10
split %0 -v -l 3
split %4 -h -b -l 5
split %3 -v -f
split %1 -h -f -b -l 12
split %0 -v -l 50%
split %8 -h -l 30%
split %6 -h
split %6 -h
split %6 -h
split %6 -h
split %6 -h
split %2 -v -d
split %0 -h -l 200
split %0 -h -b -l 200
